value.rationale: A published open direction requests treatment of symmetric pentagonal notches. This theorem delivers a complete sharp optimization of their natural centered-trapezoid three-parameter family with unique algebraic limiting optimizer, nonattainment and finite witness, clarifying a mechanism of Euclidean perimeter comparison failure. It is a strict subclass result, not a record global bound; its mathematical contribution is an exact natural classification.
